name: La Lonja de la Seda de Valencia
description: La Lonja de la Seda is a late Gothic merchants' exchange in the heart of Valencia, Spain, built between 1482 and 1533 for trading silk. Its showpiece is the vast Contract Hall, where slender, spiralling stone columns rise like palm trunks to a vaulted ceiling. The building recalls the wealth of Valencia as a leading Mediterranean trading city.
